description: Phase N J09 saved-departure board persistence parity. `root` is the decoded SavedDeparturesRoot; `encoded` is the canonical compact wire blob Kotlin ReminderContract.encodeSavedDeparturesRoot produces. web web-reminders.js and the iOS store must encode `root` to exactly `encoded` and decode `encoded` back to `root`, so the persisted blob round-trips byte-for-byte across clients. Field order is fixed (root: schemaVersion, savedDepartures; item: lineId, stationId, stationName, destination, scheduledTime, departureEpochSeconds, leadSeconds, createdAt, schemaVersion). An empty or blank blob decodes to a fresh empty list (never corrupt); a schemaVersion greater than the build's is Unsupported, not Corrupt.
